description:
Here are the descriptions of the provided plots, following your guidelines:

Both plots share a common x-axis labeled "Steps" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, with tick labels at intervals of 100. The y-axis is labeled "Training Rewards" with a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.4 for the top plot and 0.0 to 0.2 for the bottom plot, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1.

The first plot, titled "Easy Training Set", displays two lines. A blue line, labeled "Llama-LUFFY-Easy", begins at approximately (0, 0.05) and increases to approximately (500, 0.35), exhibiting fluctuations throughout. A red line, also labeled "Llama-LUFFY-Easy", begins at approximately (0, 0.05) and increases to approximately (500, 0.38), also with fluctuations. Both lines are solid and are accompanied by shaded regions representing variability. 

The second plot, titled "Hard Training Set", also displays two lines. A blue line, labeled "Llama-On-Policy-Hard", begins at approximately (0, 0.01) and increases to approximately (500, 0.15), with fluctuations. A red line, labeled "Llama-LUFFY-Hard", begins at approximately (0, 0.01) and increases to approximately (500, 0.20), also with fluctuations. Both lines are solid and are accompanied by shaded regions representing variability.
